## AgriSage Pull Request

### 📌 Summary of Changes
- Briefly describe the feature, bugfix, or enhancement.

### 🧪 Verification & Testing
- [ ] Backend tests passing (`pytest tests/`)
- [ ] Android unit tests passing (`./gradlew test`)
- [ ] Manual verification completed on Android emulator / device
- [ ] No regression introduced to existing microservices or agent graphs

### 🔐 Security & Data Compliance
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or secrets hardcoded
- [ ] RLS / Row Level Security maintained for farm & observation entities
- [ ] Proper error handling and logging (structlog) implemented

### 📷 Screenshots / Evidence (if UI)
- Attach screenshots or recordings of Compose screens / API responses here.
